featuredArticle.title: AI Lead Scoring for Aged Lists: Rank Your Buy List Before You Dial
featuredArticle.spotlight: Most aged-lead operations dial in arrival order — the slowest path to revenue. A weighted scoring model can double your contact-to-conversion rate by prioritizing your highest-probability records. This post breaks down three tiers of sophistication, from basic spreadsheet formulas to full AI integration.
